Build a self-contained gdalraster package

Source: R/gdal_build.R
gdal_build_gdalraster.Rd

Compiles gdalraster against the managed GDAL SDK, vendors the bundle's DLL dependency closure, GDAL/PROJ data, and pure-Python utilities into the installed package, then records build provenance.

Usage

gdal_build_gdalraster(
  gdal_home = default_gdal_home(),
  lib = NULL,
  user_lib = FALSE,
  source_tarball = NULL,
  repo = .gdalraster_repo,
  ref = "HEAD",
  upgrade = FALSE,
  repos = getOption("repos"),
  force = FALSE,
  enable_python = TRUE
)

Arguments

gdal_home

Installed GDAL build runtime.

lib

Destination library. The default is an isolated package-managed library.

user_lib

Install into .libPaths()[1]. This is destructive when an existing gdalraster is installed there and requires force = TRUE in non-interactive sessions.

source_tarball

Optional local gdalraster source tarball.

repo

Upstream source repository.

ref

Git reference used for the source archive.

upgrade

Install missing R dependencies before compiling.

repos

CRAN-like repositories used when upgrade = TRUE.

force

Replace an existing gdalraster package.

enable_python

Provision the managed embedded-Python .pth file after installation when possible.

Value

Invisibly, the destination library.
